review_rules: Yokuda's destruction has competing explanations; preserve natural, political, magical and sword-related accounts separately
Pankratosword claims require especially strong provenance and must not be generalized from later fan interpretation
Sword-singer and Ansei feats should distinguish instructional tradition, heroic literature and directly evidenced capability
Crowns and Forebears are historical/political traditions whose positions vary by era; do not make them timeless monoliths
Yokudan theology such as the Walkabout and Far Shores should retain source/cultural framing rather than be flattened into universal cosmology
Cross-link existing Yokuda, Redguard, Hammerfell, Frandar Hunding, Makela Leki, Sword-singers, Ansei, Shehai, Crowns, Forebears and Stros M'Kai records
